subject: Everly pilot - capacity cushion & regional pacing request
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@everly.co>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Everly Ops <ops@everly.co>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot traffic forecast + initial quota ask

Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team is excited. Attached is our traffic forecast for the two-week pilot (everly_traffic_forecast_v2.xlsx). Quick summary: Week 1 will be a controlled soft-launch to 10k users (approx 20 req/s average, short peaks to ~150 req/s), Week 2 progressive ramp to 40k users (average 80 req/s, peaks ~350 req/s).

Important details:
- Model: we plan to use a 7B conversational model (avg tokens per request ~1,200 including system & user).
- Typical session: 3–4 back-and-forth turns.
- Expected burst profile: 2–3x baseline for 1–2 hour windows tied to marketing pushes.

Ask: can Redwood provision a temporary ingress cushion (2x baseline headroom) for the first 72 hours of Week 1 and provide a regional fallback to eu-west if us capacity hits thresholds? We'd also like to schedule a pre-warm window.

Attached: forecast and a draft MPA (we'll send signed copy if we get temporary uplift in place).

Samir
Senior PM, Everly

Attachments: everly_traffic_forecast_v2.xlsx (Excel forecast)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@everly.co>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot traffic forecast + initial quota ask

Samir — thanks for the file and clear summary. Looping in product (Neha), infra (Rishi) and my manager (Marissa) to align on what we can support for the pilot. A few quick clarifications for the team:

- Can you confirm average tokens per full session (request + response + context) vs per request? Your note says ~1,200 tokens per request but I want to confirm per round-trip vs per-turn.
- Which model variant exactly (redwood-7b-v1 or a custom fork)?
- Do you need guaranteed throughput or best-effort with automatic fallback to eu-west?

Goal from our side: propose an actionable cadence for a temporary quota uplift, pre-warm window and automated rollback triggers (hours, error rate, token consumption). I attached your forecast with a couple of highlighted rows where we need specifics.

Internal next steps: Neha — can you review product constraints and confirm whether a 72-hour 2x cushion is safe from a quality/regression perspective? Rishi — can infra create a short-lived entitlement and regional routing plan if product signs off?

Thanks — I will coordinate schedule with Everly once we have an internal plan.

— Kimberly
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
phone: +1 415 555 0123

Attachments: everly_traffic_forecast_v2.xlsx (annotated)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot traffic forecast + initial quota ask

Thanks Kimberly & Samir (copied over). Quick product notes after scanning the forecast:

- Token accounting: we bill/limit on emitted+consumed tokens per request. If your "~1,200 tokens" is per single prompt-to-response exchange, multiply by number of turns. If it's per entire session, that changes quota math significantly.
- Model variants: redwood-7b-v1 and the quantized rd7b-q have different latency/cost profiles; please confirm which you intend to use. If you pick rd7b-q we can give higher bursts with lower cost but slightly different quality characteristics.
- Quality/regression: product is comfortable approving a temporary 3x burst for the first 24 hours and 2x for the next 48 hours provided: (a) experiment is tagged in our monitoring, (b) sampled outputs are routed to the eval pipeline, and (c) Everly agrees to a one-hour pre-warm window the morning of the launch to pre-populate KV/cache for common prefixes.

Neha
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference

Related docs: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1EverlyForecastV2 (forecast)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot traffic forecast + initial quota ask

On Thu, Dec 10, 2026 at 10:02 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Samir — thanks for the file and clear summary. Looping in product (Neha), infra (Rishi) and my manager (Marissa) to align on what we can support for the pilot.

Thanks all — infra review notes and proposed operational plan:

1) Temporary entitlement
- Create a named temporary entitlement: EVERLY_LAUNCH_DEC12_2026.
- Per-minute token cap: baseline (as-provisioned) x3 for first 24 hours, x2 for hours 25–72. Baseline numbers taken from the forecast spreadsheet (we will reconcile exact baseline with Kimberly).
- Per-day cap: set to forecast + 30% headroom to avoid runaway.

2) Regional routing/fallback
- Primary: us-west region. Fallback: eu-west with cross-region cold-start mitigation (we'll route only if us-west latency > 250ms or available capacity < 20%).

3) Pre-warm / KV caching
- Schedule a one-hour pre-warm that will run synthetic common prefixes to populate KV. This will reduce first-request latencies and token spend for repeated prompts.

4) Throttling policy & rollback
- If 5xx error rate > 1.5% or token consumption > 110% of provisioned window for two consecutive 15-min windows, automated rollback to baseline will trigger and paging will occur to the on-call infra lead.

5) Implementation ETA
- We can create the entitlement and routing change as a controlled feature flag within 4 business hours after final numbers are confirmed. We will need an approved DocuSign MPA or signed email confirmation from Everly to proceed (legal/procurement request).

I'll prepare the entitlement config and a shorthand runbook. Kimberly — please confirm the exact baseline numbers and deploy window.

— Rishi
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

Related playbook: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1EverlyLaunchPlaybook

From: Samir Gupta <samir@everly.co>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Everly Ops <ops@everly.co>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot traffic forecast + initial quota ask

Kimberly / team — this plan looks good. Confirmation from Everly side:

- Model: we will use redwood-7b-v1 (not quantized) for the pilot.
- Token accounting: Samir confirms 1,200 tokens per request (per turn); average session is 3 turns.
- We approve the 3x / 2x temporary uplift window and pre-warm.
- We will e-sign the MPA this afternoon and email the signed PDF (everly_signed_mpa_draft.pdf).

Schedule request: start pre-warm 08:00 PT Monday (12/14), go live at 09:00 PT with the uplift window starting at 09:00 PT. If anything changes please notify by PagerDuty as per the runbook.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth pilot.

Samir
Senior PM, Everly

Attachments: everly_signed_mpa_draft.pdf (signed MPA)
